data.title: Special Forces for Environmental Security Operate Seven Commands, 49 Field Centers in Royal and Natural Reserves
data.content:
Riyadh, November 20, 2026, SPA -- The Special Forces for Environmental Security, a branch of the Ministry of Interior established in 2018, have achieved significant environmental milestones through monitoring, security investigations, arrests, violation citations, and security support.
    The Ministry of Interior has strengthened the forces' enforcement of environmental regulations by setting up seven commands, covering Riyadh, Makkah, Eastern, Madinah, Aseer, and Hail regions and Hafr Al-Batin Governorate, along with 49 field centers in royal and natural reserves.
    The ministry says its environmental efforts have helped preserve plant species, increase vegetation cover, rehabilitate land, and return wildlife to natural habitats, and have made the Kingdom one of the world's fastest-growing countries in green space.
    The ministry continues to build the forces' capabilities and expand their presence across the Kingdom's regions, governorates, and reserves, equipping them with skilled personnel, specialized vehicles, drones, artificial intelligence systems, and round-the-clock operations centers to protect the environment.
    -- SPA
